verdict.rationale: Clara's docs have a dedicated sandbox page for testing integrations end-to-end without affecting real data or triggering real financial operations. They also document sandbox-specific test endpoints such as on-demand webhook events via `/api-test/v3/webhooks/events`. Missing for 10: details on sandbox credentials and how they are separated from production, whether MCP or agent workflows can target the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
